news.title: Four AI agents coordinating in real time outperformed Claude Opus 4.8 on enterprise coding tasks
news.summary_raw: As enterprise codebases grow, AI agents tasked with analyzing them are buckling under the weight of long-horizon tasks that require multiple interactions and tool calls. Dividing the work among a team of agents seems like the obvious fix, but it introduces a fatal flaw: most multi-agent systems are not designed for agents to coordinate among themselves mid-task and in real time.To solve this, researchers at Coral AI Labs and multiple universities introduced AgentRadio, an asynchronous message-pa
news.summary: Researchers at Coral AI Labs and multiple universities introduced AgentRadio, an asynchronous message-passing framework for four AI agents to coordinate in real-time. This allows AI agents to divide and conquer long-horizon tasks, improving performance on enterprise coding tasks, outperforming Claude Opus 4.8.
news.enterprise_use: While this is a research breakthrough, its practical applications can be seen in future AI tools like code analysis and audit software, where multiple agents may work together to analyze codebases. IT teams should note this development in potential future upgrades or integrations of AI-powered code analysis tools.
